panels.title: Per-host CPU, memory, disk, and network latency timeseries for Mac signer workers

panels.description:
CPU utilization for host **${hostname}** (macOS). Single series, 0–100%.

**Series:**
- **CPU %** — `snmp-load-average` check, metric `cpu_prct_used`.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "marlin-icinga2")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "snmp-load" and r.service == "snmp-load-average" and r.metric == "cpu_prct_used" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.hostname == "${hostname}")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value), series: "CPU %" }))
  |> group(columns: ["series"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.title: CPU

panels.description:
Memory and disk usage for host **${hostname}** (macOS). Bytes (decimal).

**Series:**
- **RAM Used** — `snmp-memory-usage`, metric `ram_used` (KB → bytes).
- **Swap Used** — `snmp-memory-usage`, metric `swap_used` (KB → bytes).
- **Disk <metric>** — `snmp-disk` (measurement `snmp-storage`); one series per disk metric tag (e.g., `used`, `total`).

targets.query:
ram = from(bucket: "marlin-icinga2")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "snmp-memory" and r.service == "snmp-memory-usage" and r.metric == "ram_used" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.hostname == "${hostname}")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: float(v: r._value) * 1024.0, series: "RAM Used"}))

swap = from(bucket: "marlin-icinga2")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "snmp-memory" and r.service == "snmp-memory-usage" and r.metric == "swap_used" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.hostname == "${hostname}")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: float(v: r._value) * 1024.0, series: "Swap Used"}))

disk = from(bucket: "marlin-icinga2")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "snmp-storage" and r.service == "snmp-disk" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.hostname == "${hostname}")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: float(v: r._value), series: "Disk " + r.metric}))

union(tables: [ram, swap, disk])
  |> group(columns: ["series"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.title: Memory and Disk

panels.description:
Network round-trip and SSH connection time for host **${hostname}** (macOS), milliseconds.

**Series:**
- **Ping RTA** — `hostalive` ping round-trip time (ms).
- **SSH Time** — `ssh` check connection time (scaled to ms).

targets.query:
rta = from(bucket: "marlin-icinga2")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "hostalive" and r.metric == "rta" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.hostname == "${hostname}")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value), series: "Ping RTA" }))

sshTime = from(bucket: "marlin-icinga2")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ssh" and r.service == "ssh" and r.metric == "time" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.hostname == "${hostname}")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) * 1000.0, series: "SSH Time" }))

union(tables: [rta, sshTime])
  |> group(columns: ["series"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.title: Network Latency

list.definition:
from(bucket: "marlin-icinga2")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "host_pool" and r._field == "pool" and r.hostname =~ /^macmini-/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value =~ /signer/)
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> distinct(column: "_value")
  |> sort()
